description_en: Submits a batch request to transfer table ownership
name: SubmitBatchChangeTableOwner

parameters.help_en: The target owner after the transfer. Use the Alibaba Cloud UID
parameters.help_zh: 转交后的目标Owner， 使用阿里云uid
parameters.name: owner

parameters.help_en: The list of MaxCompute table metadata entity IDs to transfer. A maximum of 100 tables are allowed per request. Duplicate values are not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 待转交的MaxCompute表元数据实体ID列表，单次最多100张，不允许重复
parameters.name: table_meta_entity_ids

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to allow transferring ownership to an owner in a different tenant. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 是否允许转交给跨租户的owner, 缺省false
parameters.name: enable_cross_tenant

Data.description_en: The submit result of the batch table ownership transfer task
Data.description_zh: 批量转交表Owner任务的提交结果

BatchId.description_en: The batch transfer task ID. You can use this ID to call GetBatchChangeTableOwnerStatus to query the task progress
BatchId.description_zh: 批量转交任务ID，用于调用GetBatchChangeTableOwnerStatus查询进度
BatchId.title_en: 批量转交任务ID，用于调用GetBatchChangeTableOwnerStatus查询进度
BatchId.title_zh: 批量转交任务ID，用于调用GetBatchChangeTableOwnerStatus查询进度

Status.description_en: The initial status of the task after submission
Status.description_zh: 任务提交后的初始状态
Status.title_en: 任务提交后的初始状态
Status.title_zh: 任务提交后的初始状态

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of tables submitted in this batch

Data.title_en: 批量转交表Owner任务的提交结果
Data.title_zh: 批量转交表Owner任务的提交结果

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
